messages:
ops_jess: heads-up: seeing a sudden spike of 503s from hosted infer in us-west-2 starting ~12:34UTC. requests land on runner pool 'hotmodel-quant' and we have a bunch of container restarts. stack traces in the runner logs look like kernel pagefaults during prefetch on quantized models. customer impact: a few enterprise tenants are hitting timeouts. pinging eng-oncall and infra.
eng_oncall_raj: ack. can you paste the top-of-log snippets and the affected model alias + recent deploy id? any recent config changes? :eyes:
deploybot: deploy finished: quant-swap-v2 -> pool hotmodel-quant @ 2026-02-28T12:33:59Z (deployed by ci/pipeline/quant-swap)
ops_jess: snippet from runner stderr (truncated):
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: GPU page fault: read fault at 0x7f2c0000
[ 1234.567901] kernel: [UDF] kernel BUG at mm/mmap.c:1234
[ 1234.567902] infer-runner[11234]: segfault ip=0x7f2c001234 sp=0x7ffd...
```
ml_sam: seeing same in gpu node dmesg. also nvml reports "page_fault" followed by container OOM kill in a few cases. looks correlated with kv-prefetch path + quant decoder change in v2. reproduces locally when prefetch enabled + long context > 8k tokens.
infra_yael: mitigation options: 1) roll back quant-swap-v2 from pool, 2) disable prefetch on hotmodel-quant, or 3) route traffic off the pool to warm pool. recommendation: quick rollback until we get a repro. I can cordon/drain affected nodes if we want to cycle them.
cs_tara: FYI acme-corp (acct acme-001) reported 18% 503 rate and some timed-out API calls. CSR is asking for ETA, holding on standby for a phone bridge.
eng_oncall_raj: mitigation steps I'd like executed asap:
- temporarily update routing alias to avoid quant-v2:
  `redwoodctl route update --alias hosted-default --model-variant quant-v1 --region us-west-2`
- set prefetch=false for pool hotmodel-quant in control plane or scale pool down
- cordon very unstable nodes: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-42`
ops_jess: running the route flip now.
monitoring_bot: alert: cohort=hosted-infer-us-west-2, rule=runner-exit-spike, fired=162 events in 3m. link: https://monitoring.redwood.example/alert/162
ml_sam: repro notes I'm putting on the incident channel: reproduce with small script that issues batched decode + toolcall overhead against quant-v2 while prefetch=on and batch_size=8. rough payload snippet:
```
for i in 1..50:
  post /v1/generate { model: "quant-v2", prompt: long_context(9000), batch_size: 8, prefetch: true }
```
we see pagefaults in ~10-30 requests.
infra_yael: please grab `dmesg` + `journalctl -u infer-runner` from one of the failing nodes and save to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/6060606060/
eng_oncall_raj: also collect coredumps and kernel oops:
`sudo coredumpctl dump --output=/tmp/runner.core`
`sudo cat /proc/last_kmsg > /tmp/last_kmsg.txt` (or `journalctl -k -b` on non-embedded)
ops_jess: started the syslog collection and opened s3 path above. rolling back quant-swap-v2 to quant-v1 for pool hotmodel-quant, and routing change applied. will monitor.
cs_tara: told acme-corp that we're rolling traffic and will follow up in 15m. they asked for a postmortem and repro steps.
eng_oncall_raj: assigning to eng-ml (ml_sam) + eng-infra (infra_yael) to debug root cause and test a hotfix (disable prefetch in decoder or add bounds check in KV prefetch). keep CS updated. :thumbsup:
ops_jess: thanks — monitoring shows 503s dropping after route flip. will keep the bridge open until we confirm stability.
